analysis.summary: Management reported a strong first half of FY27 with consolidated revenue growing 83% year-over-year and profit after tax increasing 71%, supported by execution across multiple programs and an expanding customer base. The company highlighted a consolidated unexecuted order book of approximately INR 733 crores as of September 30, 2026, alongside record order bookings and order book growth in their U.S. entity, AIC. Furthermore, management noted strategic expansion plans including preferential fundraising of approximately INR 205 crores and potential acquisitions in Southern India, North America, and Mexico. Aimtron Electronics Limited released its investor presentation for H1 FY2027, reporting strong financial growth with consolidated revenue reaching Rs 2,247.1 Mn and net profit at Rs 347.9 Mn.

guidance.claim: The management expects to reach the INR 1,000 crore revenue milestone organically within the next 2 years.
guidance.quote: So if we go organically, probably next 2 years from here, considering our 40%, 50% CAGR growth, as an as assurity from our side, that's what we are heading towards.

guidance.claim: Management targets a 40% to 50% CAGR growth trajectory for the coming years.
guidance.quote: Probably we'll keep our strategy in line with 40%, 50% CAGR growth because next couple of years with this year, I would say, next couple of years, we eyeing on ₹1,000 crores kind of a journey.

guidance.claim: Consolidated EBITDA and PAT margins are expected to remain around 20% to 22% and around 15% respectively.
guidance.quote: EBITDA 20% to 22% kind of a range will be intact on the consolidation mode.

guidance.claim: Aimtron International Controls is projected to achieve around $17 million in revenue.
guidance.quote: And this year will be somewhere around ₹17 million approximately. That is what we are eyeing in to.

demand_outlook.claim: AIC recorded its highest-ever quarterly order booking of around $12 million in Q2 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: AIC recorded its highest ever quarterly order booking of around $12 million compared to their average quarterly of less than or around somewhere around $4 million.

demand_outlook.claim: The consolidated unexecuted order book was approximately INR 733 crores as of September 30, 2026.
demand_outlook.quote: Our consolidated unexecuted order book stood at approximately INR 733 crores as of September 30, 2026.

demand_outlook.claim: Oil and gas sector demand is seeing good traction amid geopolitical situations.
demand_outlook.quote: So considering that number, like oil and gas, we are seeing a good traction. And considering to what geopolitical situations are, it seems to be on a better side to be on that spot as well.

demand_outlook.claim: The open order book and pipeline for the company is approximately $70 to $80 million.
demand_outlook.quote: And also when bigger company comes, they have a bigger overhead and it's very hard to move Titanic versus speedboat. So, our Aimtron's goal is to be a speedboat versus Titanic.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating suitable acquisition opportunities in Southern India, North America, and Mexico.
capex_expansion.quote: As a part of our strategic expansion, we are also evaluating suitable acquisition opportunities right now in Southern India, maybe in Bangalore or part of that area, and maybe in a North American area, maybe in Mexico.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction is ongoing for the greenfield project featuring three verticals: plastic, sheet metal, and wire harness.
capex_expansion.quote: So basically, coming down to the greenfield project, constructions are already ongoing. In the investor's presentation, we already shared couple of photos of how the building would look like. And there, we are planning like three verticals of it, plastic, sheet metal, and wire harness.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is undertaking a greenfield project for Aimtron Mechatronics focusing on backward integration.
The new Mechatronics facility will feature an initial setup of two SMT lines expanding to four.
capex_expansion.quote: But Mechatronic will have another setup with two SMT lines to start with and four SMT lines over there.

capex_expansion.claim: Aimtron acquired a company in Decatur, Illinois, renamed as Aimtron International Controls.
capex_expansion.quote: You see that we have already acquired a company in Decatur, Illinois, and building a deeper customer relationship like a stickiness of the customer and creating a more professional, scalable, and future-ready organisation.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR 224.71 crores with an EBITDA margin of approximately 24.17%.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR 224.71 crores compared with INR 122.58 crores in the corresponding period last year, representing the growth of approximately 83%. Our reported EBITDA increased approximately 80% to INR 54.30 crores compared with INR 30.11 crores last year, with an EBITDA margin of approximately 24.17%.

margins_costs.claim: The mid-term objective is to progressively bring AIC's margin closer to that of Aimtron India.
margins_costs.quote: Our mid-term objective is to progressively bring AIC's margin closer to that of Aimtron India.

margins_costs.claim: For FY26, EBITDA margin stood at 22.6% and PAT margin stood at 15.3%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 22.6% in FY '26. PAT margin stood at 15.3% in FY '26.

margins_costs.claim: Semiconductor shortages exist, but there is no direct pricing impact on EBITDA or PAT.
margins_costs.quote: So at this point, Aimtron's book, yes, we have some semiconductor shortage, but we do not have that any pricing impact at this point on our EBITDA or on our PAT.

orders_capacity.claim: The closing order book as on 30th September 2026 stood at Rs 7,333 Mn.
The RFQ pipeline is noted at INR 14+ Bn.
The combined open order book stands at approximately ₹600 crores across group companies.
orders_capacity.quote: Certainly, like, so if we combine all group of companies, probably we stand at somewhere around ₹600 crores kind of an open order book that includes Aimtron India as well as AIC in total.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates nine SMT lines currently.
orders_capacity.quote: If you look at this, you don't need that much because we already have nine SMT lines right now. So in nine SMT lines, we can easily go up to ₹800 crores, ₹900 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Shareholders approved a proposed preferential fundraise of approximately INR 205 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: An important development has been the recent shareholder approval for our proposed preferential fundraise of approximately INR 205 crore.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry continues to face challenges arising from geopolitical uncertainties and supply chain constraints.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, the industry continue to face challenges, arising from geopolitical uncertainties and supply chain constraints.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching the INR 1,000 crore revenue milestone within the next 2 years organically.
management_commitments.quote: So if we go organically, probably next 2 years from here, considering our 40%, 50% CAGR growth, as an as assurity from our side, that's what we are heading towards.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to reach a ₹1,000 crores revenue journey over the next couple of years.
management_commitments.quote: Probably we'll keep our strategy in line with 40%, 50% CAGR growth because next couple of years with this year, I would say, next couple of years, we eyeing on ₹1,000 crores kind of a journey.

management_commitments.claim: RDSO railway approvals are expected to achieve closure in the first half or third quarter of the year.
management_commitments.quote: RDSO is something that is under progress and probably this year by first half or probably by third quarter, we expect to make a closure on that part.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
